# opnsense_acme_validation (Resource)

Manages an os-acme-client DNS-01 validation. `dns_nsupdate_key` is sensitive and write-only; pair it with an ephemeral input and bump `dns_nsupdate_key_version` on rotation.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `dns_nsupdate_server` (String)
- `dns_nsupdate_zone` (String)
- `name` (String)

### Optional

> **NOTE**: [Write-only arguments](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/resources/ephemeral#write-only-arguments) are supported in Terraform 1.11 and later.

- `description` (String)
- `dns_nsupdate_key` (String, Sensitive, [Write-only](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/resources/ephemeral#write-only-arguments)) Write-only nsupdate key-file content. The value is never stored in plan or state.
- `dns_nsupdate_key_version` (Number)
- `dns_service` (String)
- `enabled` (Boolean)
- `method` (String)

### Read-Only

- `dns_nsupdate_key_configured` (Boolean)
- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
